datasets.name: call_center
datasets.description: A slowly changing dimension table that maintains the history of call center facilities, including their operational attributes, geographic location, organizational hierarchy, and market assignment. Each row represents a version of a call center with effective date ranges.

fields.name: cc_call_center_sk
fields.label: Call Center Surrogate Key
fields.description: Unique surrogate key that identifies each row in the call center dimension table.

fields.name: cc_call_center_id
fields.label: Call Center ID
fields.description: Business identifier for the call center facility, used to track the same physical location across multiple versions in the slowly changing dimension.

fields.name: cc_rec_start_date
fields.label: Record Start Date
fields.description: The date when this version of the call center record became effective.

fields.name: cc_rec_end_date
fields.label: Record End Date
fields.description: The date when this version of the call center record expired; null indicates the current active version.

fields.name: cc_closed_date_sk
fields.label: Closed Date Surrogate Key
fields.description: Foreign key reference to the date dimension for when the call center closed; always null in this dataset.

fields.name: cc_open_date_sk
fields.label: Open Date
fields.description: Foreign key reference to the date dimension indicating when the call center opened.

fields.name: cc_name
fields.label: Call Center Name
fields.description: The geographic or regional name of the call center facility.

fields.name: cc_class
fields.label: Call Center Class
fields.description: The size classification of the call center, such as 'large' or 'medium'.

fields.name: cc_employees
fields.label: Employee Count
fields.description: The number of employees working at the call center.

fields.name: cc_sq_ft
fields.label: Square Footage
fields.description: The physical size of the call center facility in square feet.

fields.name: cc_hours
fields.label: Operating Hours
fields.description: The daily operating hours of the call center, such as '8AM-4PM' or '8AM-8AM'.

fields.name: cc_manager
fields.label: Call Center Manager
fields.description: The name of the manager responsible for the call center facility.

fields.name: cc_mkt_id
fields.label: Market ID
fields.description: Identifier for the marketing region to which the call center is assigned.

fields.name: cc_mkt_class
fields.label: Market Class
fields.description: Classification or category of the marketing region.

fields.name: cc_mkt_desc
fields.label: Market Description
fields.description: Descriptive text about the marketing region and its characteristics.

fields.name: cc_market_manager
fields.label: Market Manager
fields.description: The name of the manager responsible for the marketing region.

fields.name: cc_division
fields.label: Division ID
fields.description: Identifier for the organizational division to which the call center belongs.

fields.name: cc_division_name
fields.label: Division Name
fields.description: The name of the organizational division to which the call center belongs.

fields.name: cc_company
fields.label: Company ID
fields.description: Identifier for the legal company to which the call center belongs.

fields.name: cc_company_name
fields.label: Company Name
fields.description: The name of the legal company to which the call center belongs.

fields.name: cc_street_number
fields.label: Street Number
fields.description: The street number component of the call center's address.

fields.name: cc_street_name
fields.label: Street Name
fields.description: The street name component of the call center's address.

fields.name: cc_street_type
fields.label: Street Type
fields.description: The street type component of the call center's address, such as 'Boulevard' or 'Way'.

fields.name: cc_suite_number
fields.label: Suite Number
fields.description: The suite or unit number component of the call center's address.

fields.name: cc_city
fields.label: City
fields.description: The city where the call center is located.

fields.name: cc_county
fields.label: County
fields.description: The county where the call center is located.

fields.name: cc_state
fields.label: State
fields.description: The state or province where the call center is located.

fields.name: cc_zip
fields.label: Zip Code
fields.description: The postal zip code where the call center is located.

fields.name: cc_country
fields.label: Country
fields.description: The country where the call center is located.

fields.name: cc_gmt_offset
fields.label: GMT Offset
fields.description: The time-zone offset from GMT in hours for the call center's location.

fields.name: cc_tax_percentage
fields.label: Tax Percentage
fields.description: The sales tax rate applied at the call center's location.

datasets.name: catalog_page
datasets.description: A dimension table that describes pages in printed catalogs. Each row represents a unique catalog page with its validity dates, catalog and page numbers, department, type, and descriptive information. This table is used to provide context for catalog sales and returns transactions.

fields.name: cp_catalog_page_sk
fields.label: Catalog Page Surrogate Key
fields.description: A unique surrogate key that identifies each catalog page record.

fields.name: cp_catalog_page_id
fields.label: Catalog Page ID
fields.description: A unique business identifier for each catalog page.

fields.name: cp_start_date_sk
fields.label: Start Date
fields.description: The date when the catalog page became valid, linked to the date dimension table.

fields.name: cp_end_date_sk
fields.label: End Date
fields.description: The date when the catalog page was no longer valid, linked to the date dimension table.

fields.name: cp_department
fields.label: Department
fields.description: The department classification for the catalog page. Currently contains a single value in the dataset.

fields.name: cp_catalog_number
fields.label: Catalog Number
fields.description: The catalog number that identifies which catalog edition this page belongs to.

fields.name: cp_catalog_page_number
fields.label: Catalog Page Number
fields.description: The page number within the catalog, indicating the sequential position of this page.

fields.name: cp_description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: A text description of the catalog page content or theme.

fields.name: cp_type
fields.label: Catalog Type
fields.description: The publication frequency or type of the catalog, such as bi-annual or quarterly.

datasets.name: catalog_returns
datasets.description: Records individual catalog order returns processed by the retailer, including quantities, refund amounts, fees, and the customers and locations involved. Each row represents one item returned from a catalog order.

fields.name: cr_returned_date_sk
fields.label: Returned Date
fields.description: Date the return was processed, linked to the date dimension for time-based analysis.

fields.name: cr_returned_time_sk
fields.label: Time of Day
fields.description: Time of day the return was processed, linked to the time dimension with hour, minute, and shift attributes.

fields.name: cr_item_sk
fields.label: Item
fields.description: The product that was returned, linked to the item dimension which includes versioned pricing and attributes.

fields.name: cr_refunded_customer_sk
fields.label: Refunded Customer
fields.description: The customer who received the refund, typically the original buyer of the catalog order.

fields.name: cr_refunded_cdemo_sk
fields.label: Refunded Customer Demographics
fields.description: Demographic attributes of the customer receiving the refund, linked to the customer demographics dimension.

fields.name: cr_refunded_hdemo_sk
fields.label: Refunded Household Demographics
fields.description: Household demographic attributes of the customer receiving the refund, linked to the household demographics dimension.

fields.name: cr_refunded_addr_sk
fields.label: Refunded Address
fields.description: Address where the refund was sent, linked to the customer address dimension.

fields.name: cr_returning_customer_sk
fields.label: Returning Customer
fields.description: The customer who physically returned the goods, which may differ from the refunded customer.

fields.name: cr_returning_cdemo_sk
fields.label: Returning Customer Demographics
fields.description: Demographic attributes of the customer who physically returned the goods, linked to the customer demographics dimension.

fields.name: cr_returning_hdemo_sk
fields.label: Returning Household Demographics
fields.description: Household demographic attributes of the customer who physically returned the goods, linked to the household demographics dimension.

fields.name: cr_returning_addr_sk
fields.label: Returning Address
fields.description: Address from which the goods were returned, linked to the customer address dimension.

fields.name: cr_call_center_sk
fields.label: Call Center
fields.description: The call center facility that processed the return, linked to the call center dimension.

fields.name: cr_catalog_page_sk
fields.label: Catalog Page
fields.description: The page in the printed catalog from which the returned item was originally ordered, linked to the catalog page dimension.

fields.name: cr_ship_mode_sk
fields.label: Ship Mode
fields.description: The shipping service level and carrier used for the original order, linked to the ship mode dimension.

fields.name: cr_warehouse_sk
fields.label: Warehouse
fields.description: The distribution facility that shipped the original order, linked to the warehouse dimension.

fields.name: cr_reason_sk
fields.label: Return Reason
fields.description: The reason code provided by the customer for the return, linked to the reason dimension.

fields.name: cr_order_number
fields.label: Order Number
fields.description: Identifier of the catalog order from which this item was returned; groups all line items of one order.

fields.name: cr_return_quantity
fields.label: Return Quantity
fields.description: Number of units returned on this line item.

fields.name: cr_return_amount
fields.label: Return Amount
fields.description: Value of the returned goods refunded to the customer, before tax, in dollars.

fields.name: cr_return_tax
fields.label: Return Tax
fields.description: Tax refunded on the return, in dollars.

fields.name: cr_return_amt_inc_tax
fields.label: Return Amount Including Tax
fields.description: Total refund amount including tax, calculated as Return Amount + Return Tax, in dollars.

fields.name: cr_fee
fields.label: Return Fee
fields.description: Restocking or handling fee charged to the customer for the return, in dollars.

fields.name: cr_return_ship_cost
fields.label: Return Ship Cost
fields.description: Shipping cost incurred to return the goods to the retailer, in dollars.

fields.name: cr_refunded_cash
fields.label: Refunded Cash
fields.description: Portion of the refund paid to the customer in cash, in dollars.

fields.name: cr_reversed_charge
fields.label: Reversed Charge
fields.description: Portion of the refund returned by reversing the original card charge, in dollars.

fields.name: cr_store_credit
fields.label: Store Credit
fields.description: Portion of the refund issued as store or account credit to the customer, in dollars.

fields.name: cr_net_loss
fields.label: Net Loss
fields.description: Total financial loss to the retailer from the return, in dollars. Verify exact calculation formula before use in critical analyses.

datasets.name: catalog_sales
datasets.description: Transactional fact table capturing individual line items from catalog and web orders, including customer, product, pricing, and fulfillment details. Each row represents one item sold through a catalog or web channel.

fields.name: cs_sold_date_sk
fields.label: Sold Date
fields.description: Date the sale was made, linked to the date dimension for time-based analysis.

fields.name: cs_sold_time_sk
fields.label: Time of Day
fields.description: Time of day the sale was made, linked to the time dimension with hour, minute, and meal-time attributes.

fields.name: cs_ship_date_sk
fields.label: Ship Date
fields.description: Date the catalog or web order was shipped.

fields.name: cs_bill_customer_sk
fields.label: Bill-To Customer
fields.description: Customer who was billed for the order; links to the customer dimension.

fields.name: cs_bill_cdemo_sk
fields.label: Bill-To Customer Demographics
fields.description: Demographic profile of the billing customer including gender, marital status, education, credit rating, and dependents.

fields.name: cs_bill_hdemo_sk
fields.label: Bill-To Household Demographics
fields.description: Household-level profile of the billing address including income band, buying potential, dependents, and vehicles.

fields.name: cs_bill_addr_sk
fields.label: Bill-To Address
fields.description: Postal address where the customer was billed; links to the customer address dimension.

fields.name: cs_ship_customer_sk
fields.label: Ship-To Customer
fields.description: Customer the goods were shipped to; links to the customer dimension.

fields.name: cs_ship_cdemo_sk
fields.label: Ship-To Customer Demographics
fields.description: Demographic profile of the shipping customer including gender, marital status, education, credit rating, and dependents.

fields.name: cs_ship_hdemo_sk
fields.label: Ship-To Household Demographics
fields.description: Household-level profile of the shipping address including income band, buying potential, dependents, and vehicles.

fields.name: cs_ship_addr_sk
fields.label: Ship-To Address
fields.description: Postal address where the goods were shipped; links to the customer address dimension.

fields.name: cs_call_center_sk
fields.label: Call Center
fields.description: Call center facility that took the catalog order; links to the call center dimension.

fields.name: cs_catalog_page_sk
fields.label: Catalog Page
fields.description: Page in the printed catalog from which the item was ordered; links to the catalog page dimension.

fields.name: cs_ship_mode_sk
fields.label: Ship Mode
fields.description: Shipping service level and carrier used for the order; links to the ship mode dimension.

fields.name: cs_warehouse_sk
fields.label: Warehouse
fields.description: Distribution facility that shipped the order; links to the warehouse dimension.

fields.name: cs_item_sk
fields.label: Item
fields.description: Product sold; links to the item dimension which is versioned over time for price and attribute changes.

fields.name: cs_promo_sk
fields.label: Promotion
fields.description: Marketing campaign offering a discount on the item over a date range; links to the promotion dimension.

fields.name: cs_order_number
fields.label: Order Number
fields.description: Identifier of the catalog or web order; groups all line items belonging to a single order.

fields.name: cs_quantity
fields.label: Quantity Sold
fields.description: Number of units of the item on this sales line.

fields.name: cs_wholesale_cost
fields.label: Unit Wholesale Cost
fields.description: Per-unit cost to the retailer at the time of sale, in dollars.

fields.name: cs_list_price
fields.label: Unit List Price
fields.description: Per-unit list (undiscounted) price at the time of sale, in dollars.

fields.name: cs_sales_price
fields.label: Unit Sales Price
fields.description: Per-unit price actually charged before coupons, in dollars.

fields.name: cs_ext_discount_amt
fields.label: Extended Discount Amount
fields.description: Quantity Sold × (Unit List Price − Unit Sales Price); total markdown from list price, in dollars.

fields.name: cs_ext_sales_price
fields.label: Extended Sales Price
fields.description: Quantity Sold × Unit Sales Price; gross line revenue before coupons and tax, in dollars.

fields.name: cs_ext_wholesale_cost
fields.label: Extended Wholesale Cost
fields.description: Quantity Sold × Unit Wholesale Cost; total cost to the retailer for this line, in dollars.

fields.name: cs_ext_list_price
fields.label: Extended List Price
fields.description: Quantity Sold × Unit List Price; total undiscounted value of the line, in dollars.

fields.name: cs_ext_tax
fields.label: Extended Tax
fields.description: Sales tax charged on the line, computed on Net Paid, in dollars.

fields.name: cs_coupon_amt
fields.label: Coupon Amount
fields.description: Coupon discount applied to the line after the sales price, in dollars.

fields.name: cs_ext_ship_cost
fields.label: Extended Ship Cost
fields.description: Shipping charge on the catalog or web line, in dollars.

fields.name: cs_net_paid
fields.label: Net Paid
fields.description: Extended Sales Price − Coupon Amount; revenue the customer actually paid before tax and shipping, in dollars.

fields.name: cs_net_paid_inc_tax
fields.label: Net Paid Including Tax
fields.description: Net Paid + Extended Tax; total revenue including sales tax but before shipping, in dollars.

fields.name: cs_net_paid_inc_ship
fields.label: Net Paid Including Ship
fields.description: Net Paid + Extended Ship Cost; total revenue including shipping but before tax, in dollars.

fields.name: cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax
fields.label: Net Paid Including Ship and Tax
fields.description: Net Paid + Extended Ship Cost + Extended Tax; total revenue including both shipping and tax, in dollars.

synonyms: Net Paid Including Ship and Tax

fields.name: cs_net_profit
fields.label: Net Profit
fields.description: Net Paid − Extended Wholesale Cost; line-level gross profit before operating expenses, in dollars.

datasets.name: customer
datasets.description: Master dimension table containing all customers who have purchased from any channel (catalog, store, or web). Each row represents a unique customer with their demographic profile, contact information, and purchase history dates.

fields.name: c_customer_sk
fields.label: Customer Surrogate Key
fields.description: Unique surrogate key assigned to each customer for efficient joins with transaction tables.

fields.name: c_customer_id
fields.label: Customer ID
fields.description: Natural business identifier for the customer, a unique alphanumeric code assigned at customer creation.

fields.name: c_current_cdemo_sk
fields.label: Current Customer Demographics
fields.description: Link to the customer's current demographic profile including gender, marital status, education, credit rating, and dependents.

fields.name: c_current_hdemo_sk
fields.label: Current Household Demographics
fields.description: Link to the customer's current household profile including income band, buying potential, number of dependents, and vehicles owned.

fields.name: c_current_addr_sk
fields.label: Current Address
fields.description: Link to the customer's current postal address used for billing and shipping.

fields.name: c_first_shipto_date_sk
fields.label: First Ship-To Date
fields.description: Date key referencing when the customer's first order was shipped across any channel.

fields.name: c_first_sales_date_sk
fields.label: First Sale Date
fields.description: Date key referencing when the customer made their first purchase in any channel.

fields.name: c_salutation
fields.label: Salutation
fields.description: Customer's title or form of address (e.g., Dr., Mr., Mrs., Ms., Sir, Madam).

fields.name: c_first_name
fields.label: First Name
fields.description: Customer's given name.

fields.name: c_last_name
fields.label: Last Name
fields.description: Customer's family name.

fields.name: c_preferred_cust_flag
fields.label: Preferred Customer Flag
fields.description: Indicator (Y/N) showing whether the customer is enrolled in the preferred or loyalty program.

fields.name: c_birth_day
fields.label: Birth Day
fields.description: Day of the month (1-31) on which the customer was born.

fields.name: c_birth_month
fields.label: Birth Month
fields.description: Month (1-12) in which the customer was born.

fields.name: c_birth_year
fields.label: Birth Year
fields.description: Year in which the customer was born, ranging from 1924 to 1992.

fields.name: c_birth_country
fields.label: Birth Country
fields.description: Country in which the customer was born.

fields.name: c_login
fields.label: Customer Login
fields.description: Customer's web login username for online account access.

fields.name: c_email_address
fields.label: Email Address
fields.description: Customer's email address used for communications and account recovery.

fields.name: c_last_review_date_sk
fields.label: Last Review Date
fields.description: Date key indicating when the customer record was last reviewed or updated in the system.

datasets.name: customer_address
datasets.description: A dimension table containing postal addresses for customers, used across all sales channels (catalog, store, and web) for billing, shipping, and refund purposes. Each row represents a unique address with geographic and location-type attributes.

fields.name: ca_address_sk
fields.label: Address Surrogate Key
fields.description: Unique surrogate key for each address record, used internally to link addresses across fact tables.

fields.name: ca_address_id
fields.label: Address ID
fields.description: Natural business identifier for the address, providing a human-readable reference.

fields.name: ca_street_number
fields.label: Street Number
fields.description: The numeric portion of the street address (e.g., house or building number).

fields.name: ca_street_name
fields.label: Street Name
fields.description: The name of the street or road.

fields.name: ca_street_type
fields.label: Street Type
fields.description: The type of street (e.g., Avenue, Boulevard, Way), used to categorize address formats.

fields.name: ca_suite_number
fields.label: Suite Number
fields.description: The suite, apartment, or unit number within a building, used to distinguish multiple addresses at the same street location.

fields.name: ca_city
fields.label: City
fields.description: The city or municipality where the address is located, part of the geographic hierarchy.

fields.name: ca_county
fields.label: County
fields.description: The county where the address is located, part of the geographic hierarchy.

fields.name: ca_state
fields.label: State
fields.description: The U.S. state abbreviation (e.g., CA, NY, TX), used to group and filter addresses by state.

fields.name: ca_zip
fields.label: ZIP Code
fields.description: The postal ZIP code for the address, enabling precise geographic targeting.

fields.name: ca_country
fields.label: Country
fields.description: The country where the address is located; currently all values are 'United States'.

fields.name: ca_gmt_offset
fields.label: GMT Offset
fields.description: The time-zone offset from GMT in hours, ranging from -10 to -5, used for time-based analysis and reporting.

fields.name: ca_location_type
fields.label: Location Type
fields.description: The type of dwelling at the address (apartment, house, or single family), used to segment customers by residence type.

datasets.name: customer_demographics
datasets.description: A dimension table containing demographic attributes for customers, including gender, marital status, education level, credit rating, and household composition. This table is referenced across all sales and returns transactions to enable demographic analysis and segmentation.

fields.name: cd_demo_sk
fields.label: Customer Demographics Key
fields.description: Unique surrogate key identifying each customer demographic profile record.

fields.name: cd_gender
fields.label: Gender
fields.description: Customer gender, either Female (F) or Male (M).

fields.name: cd_marital_status
fields.label: Marital Status
fields.description: Customer marital status code, such as Divorced (D), Married (M), Single (S), Widowed (W), or Unknown.

fields.name: cd_education_status
fields.label: Education Status
fields.description: Highest education level attained by the customer, including categories such as 2 yr Degree, 4 yr Degree, Advanced Degree, High School, Primary, and Unknown.

fields.name: cd_purchase_estimate
fields.label: Purchase Estimate
fields.description: Estimated annual purchase amount band for the customer in whole currency units, ranging from $500 to $10,000 in increments.

fields.name: cd_credit_rating
fields.label: Credit Rating
fields.description: Credit risk classification of the customer, such as Good, Fair, Poor, or Unknown.

fields.name: cd_dep_count
fields.label: Dependent Count
fields.description: Total number of dependents in the customer's household, ranging from 0 to 6.

fields.name: cd_dep_employed_count
fields.label: Employed Dependent Count
fields.description: Number of dependents in the customer's household who are employed, ranging from 0 to 6.

fields.name: cd_dep_college_count
fields.label: College Dependent Count
fields.description: Number of dependents in the customer's household who are attending college, ranging from 0 to 6.

datasets.name: date_dim
datasets.description: A comprehensive calendar dimension table containing one row per day from 1900 to 2100, with calendar attributes (year, month, day, quarter, week), fiscal period mappings, day-of-week and holiday indicators, and period-over-period comparison keys for analyzing sales and business events across time.

fields.name: d_date_sk
fields.label: Date Surrogate Key
fields.description: Unique surrogate key for each calendar date, used as the primary identifier and foreign key in fact tables.

fields.name: d_date_id
fields.label: Date ID
fields.description: Alternate unique identifier for each calendar date in string format.

fields.name: d_date
fields.label: Calendar Date
fields.description: The actual calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD format) represented by this row.

fields.name: d_month_seq
fields.label: Month Sequence
fields.description: A monotonically increasing sequence number for each month, useful for period arithmetic and calculating month-over-month intervals.

fields.name: d_week_seq
fields.label: Week Sequence
fields.description: A monotonically increasing sequence number for each week, useful for week-over-week analysis and period calculations.

fields.name: d_quarter_seq
fields.label: Quarter Sequence
fields.description: A monotonically increasing sequence number for each quarter, useful for quarter-over-quarter analysis and period calculations.

fields.name: d_year
fields.label: Calendar Year
fields.description: The calendar year (1900–2100) of the date, used for annual grouping and year-over-year comparisons.

fields.name: d_dow
fields.label: Day of Week Number
fields.description: Numeric day of week (0–6), where 0 typically represents Sunday, used for weekday-based analysis and filtering.

fields.name: d_moy
fields.label: Month of Year
fields.description: The month number (1–12) within the calendar year, used for monthly grouping and seasonal analysis.

fields.name: d_dom
fields.label: Day of Month
fields.description: The day number (1–31) within the calendar month, used for intra-month analysis and date positioning.

fields.name: d_qoy
fields.label: Quarter of Year
fields.description: The quarter number (1–4) within the calendar year, used for quarterly grouping and seasonal analysis.

fields.name: d_fy_year
fields.label: Fiscal Year
fields.description: The fiscal year of the date, used for fiscal period grouping and year-over-year comparisons aligned to the organization's fiscal calendar.

fields.name: d_fy_quarter_seq
fields.label: Fiscal Quarter Sequence
fields.description: A monotonically increasing sequence number for each fiscal quarter, useful for fiscal period arithmetic and comparisons.

fields.name: d_fy_week_seq
fields.label: Fiscal Week Sequence
fields.description: A monotonically increasing sequence number for each fiscal week, useful for fiscal week-over-week analysis and period calculations.

fields.name: d_day_name
fields.label: Day of Week Name
fields.description: The name of the day of the week (e.g., Monday, Tuesday), used for readable day-based filtering and reporting.

fields.name: d_quarter_name
fields.label: Quarter Name
fields.description: A formatted quarter label (e.g., '2023Q1') combining the year and quarter number for readable period identification.

fields.name: d_holiday
fields.label: Is Holiday
fields.description: Flag ('Y' or 'N') indicating whether the date is a recognized holiday, used for holiday-specific analysis and filtering.

fields.name: d_weekend
fields.label: Is Weekend
fields.description: Flag ('Y' or 'N') indicating whether the date falls on a weekend (Saturday or Sunday), used for weekend vs. weekday analysis.

fields.name: d_following_holiday
fields.label: Following Holiday
fields.description: Flag ('Y' or 'N') indicating whether the date is immediately followed by a holiday, used to identify pre-holiday periods.

fields.name: d_first_dom
fields.label: First Day of Month Surrogate Key
fields.description: Surrogate key pointing to the first day of the month containing this date, enabling month-start analysis and calculations.

fields.name: d_last_dom
fields.label: Last Day of Month Surrogate Key
fields.description: Surrogate key pointing to the last day of the month containing this date, enabling month-end analysis and calculations.

fields.name: d_same_day_ly
fields.label: Same Day Last Year Surrogate Key
fields.description: Surrogate key of the equivalent calendar day one year earlier, enabling year-over-year period-on-period comparisons.

fields.name: d_same_day_lq
fields.label: Same Day Last Quarter Surrogate Key
fields.description: Surrogate key of the equivalent calendar day one quarter earlier, enabling quarter-over-quarter period-on-period comparisons.

fields.name: d_current_day
fields.label: Is Current Day
fields.description: Flag ('Y' or 'N') indicating whether the date is the current business day, used for current-period filtering in reports.

fields.name: d_current_week
fields.label: Is Current Week
fields.description: Flag ('Y' or 'N') indicating whether the date falls within the current business week, used for current-period filtering in reports.

fields.name: d_current_month
fields.label: Is Current Month
fields.description: Flag ('Y' or 'N') indicating whether the date falls within the current business month, used for current-period filtering in reports.

fields.name: d_current_quarter
fields.label: Is Current Quarter
fields.description: Flag ('Y' or 'N') indicating whether the date falls within the current business quarter, used for current-period filtering in reports.

fields.name: d_current_year
fields.label: Is Current Year
fields.description: Flag ('Y' or 'N') indicating whether the date falls within the current business year, used for current-period filtering in reports.

datasets.name: household_demographics
datasets.description: A dimension table that describes household-level demographic profiles, including income band, buying potential, number of dependents, and vehicle ownership. Each row represents a unique household demographic profile used to segment customers across sales and returns transactions.

fields.name: hd_demo_sk
fields.label: Household Demographics Key
fields.description: Unique surrogate key that identifies each household demographic profile.

fields.name: hd_income_band_sk
fields.label: Income Band Key
fields.description: Foreign key reference to the Income Band dimension table, linking each household to its annual income range.

fields.name: hd_buy_potential
fields.label: Buy Potential
fields.description: Estimated household annual spending band, categorized into ranges such as 0-500, 500-1000, 1000-5000, 5000-10000, 10000-50000, or Unknown.

fields.name: hd_dep_count
fields.label: Dependent Count
fields.description: Number of dependents in the household, ranging from 0 to 9.

fields.name: hd_vehicle_count
fields.label: Vehicle Count
fields.description: Number of vehicles owned by the household, ranging from -1 (unknown) to 4.

datasets.name: income_band
datasets.description: A lookup table that defines household annual income ranges. Each row represents a distinct income band with a lower and upper bound, used to segment customers and households by income level.

fields.name: ib_income_band_sk
fields.label: Income Band Key
fields.description: Unique surrogate key that identifies each income band record.

fields.name: ib_lower_bound
fields.label: Lower Bound
fields.description: The minimum annual household income (in dollars) for this income band, inclusive.

fields.name: ib_upper_bound
fields.label: Upper Bound
fields.description: The maximum annual household income (in dollars) for this income band, inclusive.

datasets.name: inventory
datasets.description: Weekly snapshots of inventory levels by item and warehouse. Each row represents the quantity of a specific item on hand at a warehouse on a given date.

fields.name: inv_date_sk
fields.label: Inventory Date
fields.description: The date key identifying when this inventory snapshot was taken, linking to the date dimension table.

fields.name: inv_item_sk
fields.label: Item
fields.description: The item key identifying which product this inventory record describes, linking to the item dimension table.

fields.name: inv_warehouse_sk
fields.label: Warehouse
fields.description: The warehouse key identifying which distribution facility holds this inventory, linking to the warehouse dimension table.

fields.name: inv_quantity_on_hand
fields.label: Quantity On Hand
fields.description: Units of the item held at the warehouse on the snapshot date. This is the primary measure tracked in inventory snapshots.

datasets.name: item
datasets.description: A slowly changing dimension table that maintains the history of products sold by the retailer. Each row represents a version of an item with its attributes, pricing, and classification valid during a specific time period.

fields.name: i_item_sk
fields.label: Item Surrogate Key
fields.description: Unique surrogate key that identifies each item record.

fields.name: i_item_id
fields.label: Item ID
fields.description: Business key that identifies the logical item across all its versions.

fields.name: i_rec_start_date
fields.label: Record Start Date
fields.description: The date when this version of the item became effective.

fields.name: i_rec_end_date
fields.label: Record End Date
fields.description: The date when this version of the item expired; null indicates the current version.

fields.name: i_item_desc
fields.label: Item Description
fields.description: Detailed text description of the item.

fields.name: i_current_price
fields.label: Current Price
fields.description: Current list price of this item version in dollars.

fields.name: i_wholesale_cost
fields.label: Wholesale Cost
fields.description: Standard per-unit cost the retailer pays for this item in dollars.

fields.name: i_brand_id
fields.label: Brand ID
fields.description: Identifier for the brand of the item.

fields.name: i_brand
fields.label: Brand
fields.description: Brand name of the item.

fields.name: i_class_id
fields.label: Class ID
fields.description: Identifier for the product class, the second level of the product hierarchy.

fields.name: i_class
fields.label: Class
fields.description: Product class name, the second level of the product hierarchy within a category.

fields.name: i_category_id
fields.label: Category ID
fields.description: Identifier for the product category, the top level of the product hierarchy.

fields.name: i_category
fields.label: Category
fields.description: Product category name, the top level of the product hierarchy.

fields.name: i_manufact_id
fields.label: Manufacturer ID
fields.description: Identifier for the manufacturer of the item.

fields.name: i_manufact
fields.label: Manufacturer
fields.description: Name of the manufacturer of the item.

fields.name: i_size
fields.label: Size
fields.description: Physical size attribute of the item.

fields.name: i_formulation
fields.label: Formulation
fields.description: Technical formulation code or specification for the item.

fields.name: i_color
fields.label: Color
fields.description: Color attribute of the item.

fields.name: i_units
fields.label: Units
fields.description: Unit of measure for the item (e.g., Box, Case, Pound).

fields.name: i_container
fields.label: Container
fields.description: Container type for the item; currently all values are 'Unknown'.

fields.name: i_manager_id
fields.label: Product Manager ID
fields.description: Identifier of the manager responsible for this item.

fields.name: i_product_name
fields.label: Product Name
fields.description: Display name of the product.

datasets.name: promotion
datasets.description: A dimension table containing marketing campaign promotions with their characteristics, channels, costs, and validity periods. Each row represents a unique promotion that can be applied to items and referenced in sales transactions.

fields.name: p_promo_sk
fields.label: Promotion Surrogate Key
fields.description: A unique numeric identifier for each promotion, used as the primary key and to link promotions to sales transactions.

fields.name: p_promo_id
fields.label: Promotion ID
fields.description: A unique business identifier for each promotion, providing a human-readable reference code.

fields.name: p_start_date_sk
fields.label: Promotion Start Date
fields.description: A reference to the date dimension indicating when the promotion begins. Links to the date_dim table to provide the actual start date.

fields.name: p_end_date_sk
fields.label: Promotion End Date
fields.description: A reference to the date dimension indicating when the promotion ends. Links to the date_dim table to provide the actual end date.

fields.name: p_item_sk
fields.label: Item
fields.description: A reference to the item being promoted, linking to the item dimension table. Most promotions apply to a specific product.

fields.name: p_cost
fields.label: Promotion Cost
fields.description: The amount spent to run the promotion, expressed in dollars. This represents the investment required to execute the marketing campaign.

fields.name: p_response_target
fields.label: Promotion Response Target
fields.description: A numeric indicator of the expected or desired response level for the promotion, used to set expectations for campaign performance.

fields.name: p_promo_name
fields.label: Promotion Name
fields.description: A short descriptive name or category for the promotion, such as 'able' or 'pri', used to classify and identify promotion types.

fields.name: p_channel_dmail
fields.label: Direct Mail Channel
fields.description: A flag (Y/N) indicating whether the promotion was communicated through direct mail.

fields.name: p_channel_email
fields.label: Email Channel
fields.description: A flag (Y/N) indicating whether the promotion was communicated through email. In this dataset, all values are 'N'.

fields.name: p_channel_catalog
fields.label: Catalog Channel
fields.description: A flag (Y/N) indicating whether the promotion was communicated through a catalog. In this dataset, all values are 'N'.

fields.name: p_channel_tv
fields.label: Television Channel
fields.description: A flag (Y/N) indicating whether the promotion was communicated through television. In this dataset, all values are 'N'.

fields.name: p_channel_radio
fields.label: Radio Channel
fields.description: A flag (Y/N) indicating whether the promotion was communicated through radio. In this dataset, all values are 'N'.

fields.name: p_channel_press
fields.label: Press Channel
fields.description: A flag (Y/N) indicating whether the promotion was communicated through press or print media. In this dataset, all values are 'N'.

fields.name: p_channel_event
fields.label: Event Channel
fields.description: A flag (Y/N) indicating whether the promotion was communicated through events. In this dataset, all values are 'N'.

fields.name: p_channel_demo
fields.label: Demo Channel
fields.description: A flag (Y/N) indicating whether the promotion was communicated through product demonstrations. In this dataset, all values are 'N'.

fields.name: p_channel_details
fields.label: Channel Details
fields.description: Free-form text providing additional details about the promotion channels and communication strategy used.

fields.name: p_purpose
fields.label: Promotion Purpose
fields.description: The business purpose or objective of the promotion. In this dataset, all values are 'Unknown'.

fields.name: p_discount_active
fields.label: Discount Active
fields.description: A flag (Y/N) indicating whether the promotion's discount was actively in effect. In this dataset, all values are 'N'.

datasets.name: reason
datasets.description: A lookup table containing the reasons customers provide for product returns across all sales channels (catalog, store, and web). Each reason is identified by a surrogate key and a business key, with a descriptive text explaining the return rationale.

fields.name: r_reason_sk
fields.label: Reason Surrogate Key
fields.description: A unique numeric identifier assigned to each return reason for efficient referencing in fact tables.

fields.name: r_reason_id
fields.label: Reason ID
fields.description: A unique business identifier (natural key) for each return reason, used in source systems and data loads.

fields.name: r_reason_desc
fields.label: Reason Description
fields.description: A human-readable explanation of why a customer returned a product, such as 'Did not fit' or 'unauthorized purchase'.

datasets.name: ship_mode
datasets.description: A dimension table that defines shipping service levels, carriers, and delivery methods used for orders. Each row represents a unique combination of shipping type, carrier, and contract terms.

fields.name: sm_ship_mode_sk
fields.label: Ship Mode Surrogate Key
fields.description: A unique numeric identifier for each ship mode record, used as the primary key and for efficient joins to fact tables.

fields.name: sm_ship_mode_id
fields.label: Ship Mode ID
fields.description: A unique business identifier for each ship mode, providing a stable reference across systems.

fields.name: sm_type
fields.label: Ship Mode Type
fields.description: The service level of the shipment, such as EXPRESS, TWO DAY, or STANDARD, indicating the delivery speed.

fields.name: sm_code
fields.label: Ship Mode Code
fields.description: A short code representing the shipping method or carrier type, such as AIR, RAIL, TRUCK, or SURFACE.

fields.name: sm_carrier
fields.label: Carrier
fields.description: The name of the shipping company or carrier responsible for delivering the shipment.

fields.name: sm_contract
fields.label: Carrier Contract
fields.description: A contract identifier or reference code associated with the carrier agreement for this ship mode.

datasets.name: store
datasets.description: A dimension table containing details about physical retail store locations, including operational attributes, geography, organizational hierarchy, and historical tracking through slowly changing dimension fields. Each row represents a version of a store record with effective dates.

fields.name: s_store_sk
fields.label: Store Surrogate Key
fields.description: Unique surrogate key identifying each store record version.

fields.name: s_store_id
fields.label: Store ID
fields.description: Business identifier for the store, stable across versions of the slowly changing dimension.

fields.name: s_rec_start_date
fields.label: Record Start Date
fields.description: Date when this version of the store record became effective.

fields.name: s_rec_end_date
fields.label: Record End Date
fields.description: Date when this version of the store record expired; null for the current version.

fields.name: s_closed_date_sk
fields.label: Store Closed Date
fields.description: Reference to the date dimension indicating when the store closed; null while the store remains open.

fields.name: s_store_name
fields.label: Store Name
fields.description: The name of the store.

fields.name: s_number_employees
fields.label: Number of Employees
fields.description: Count of employees working at the store.

fields.name: s_floor_space
fields.label: Floor Space
fields.description: Total floor space of the store in square feet.

fields.name: s_hours
fields.label: Store Hours
fields.description: Operating hours of the store, expressed as a time range.

fields.name: s_manager
fields.label: Store Manager
fields.description: Name of the manager responsible for the store.

fields.name: s_market_id
fields.label: Market ID
fields.description: Identifier for the marketing region to which the store belongs.

fields.name: s_geography_class
fields.label: Geography Class
fields.description: Classification of the store's geographic location.

fields.name: s_market_desc
fields.label: Market Description
fields.description: Descriptive text about the marketing region.

fields.name: s_market_manager
fields.label: Market Manager
fields.description: Name of the manager responsible for the market region.

fields.name: s_division_id
fields.label: Division ID
fields.description: Identifier for the organizational division to which the store belongs.

fields.name: s_division_name
fields.label: Division Name
fields.description: Name of the organizational division.

fields.name: s_company_id
fields.label: Company ID
fields.description: Identifier for the legal company to which the store belongs.

fields.name: s_company_name
fields.label: Company Name
fields.description: Name of the legal company.

fields.name: s_street_number
fields.label: Street Number
fields.description: Street number component of the store's address.

fields.name: s_street_name
fields.label: Street Name
fields.description: Street name component of the store's address.

fields.name: s_street_type
fields.label: Street Type
fields.description: Street type (e.g., Boulevard, Avenue, Way) component of the store's address.

fields.name: s_suite_number
fields.label: Suite Number
fields.description: Suite or unit number component of the store's address.

fields.name: s_city
fields.label: City
fields.description: City where the store is located.

fields.name: s_county
fields.label: County
fields.description: County where the store is located.

fields.name: s_state
fields.label: State
fields.description: State where the store is located.

fields.name: s_zip
fields.label: Zip Code
fields.description: Postal zip code where the store is located.

fields.name: s_country
fields.label: Country
fields.description: Country where the store is located.

fields.name: s_gmt_offset
fields.label: GMT Offset
fields.description: Time-zone offset from GMT in hours for the store's location.

fields.name: s_tax_percentage
fields.label: Tax Percentage
fields.description: Sales tax rate applied at the store, expressed as a decimal percentage.

datasets.name: store_returns
datasets.description: A fact table recording individual product returns processed at retail stores. Each row represents one line item returned by a customer, with details on the returned quantity, refund amounts, fees, and the financial impact to the retailer.

fields.name: sr_returned_date_sk
fields.label: Returned Date
fields.description: The date the return was processed, linked to the date dimension for time-based analysis.

fields.name: sr_return_time_sk
fields.label: Return Time of Day
fields.description: The time of day the return was processed, linked to the time dimension for intraday analysis.

fields.name: sr_item_sk
fields.label: Item
fields.description: Reference to the product that was returned, allowing analysis by product attributes and pricing.

fields.name: sr_customer_sk
fields.label: Customer
fields.description: Reference to the customer who initiated the return, enabling customer-level analysis and segmentation.

fields.name: sr_cdemo_sk
fields.label: Customer Demographics
fields.description: Reference to the customer's demographic profile including gender, marital status, education, and credit rating.

fields.name: sr_hdemo_sk
fields.label: Household Demographics
fields.description: Reference to household-level attributes such as income band, buying potential, and number of vehicles.

fields.name: sr_addr_sk
fields.label: Customer Address
fields.description: Reference to the customer's address, used for geographic analysis of returns.

fields.name: sr_store_sk
fields.label: Store
fields.description: Reference to the physical retail location where the return was processed.

fields.name: sr_reason_sk
fields.label: Return Reason
fields.description: Reference to the reason code provided by the customer for the return.

fields.name: sr_ticket_number
fields.label: Ticket Number
fields.description: Identifier of the store sales receipt; groups all line items from a single store visit or transaction.

fields.name: sr_return_quantity
fields.label: Return Quantity
fields.description: The number of units returned on this line item.

fields.name: sr_return_amt
fields.label: Return Amount
fields.description: The value of the returned goods refunded to the customer, before tax, in dollars.

fields.name: sr_return_tax
fields.label: Return Tax
fields.description: The tax amount refunded to the customer on the returned goods, in dollars.

fields.name: sr_return_amt_inc_tax
fields.label: Return Amount Including Tax
fields.description: The total refund amount including tax, calculated as Return Amount plus Return Tax, in dollars.

fields.name: sr_fee
fields.label: Return Fee
fields.description: Restocking or handling fee charged to the customer for processing the return, in dollars.

fields.name: sr_return_ship_cost
fields.label: Return Shipping Cost
fields.description: The shipping cost incurred to return the goods to the retailer, in dollars.

fields.name: sr_refunded_cash
fields.label: Refunded Cash
fields.description: The portion of the refund paid to the customer in cash, in dollars.

fields.name: sr_reversed_charge
fields.label: Reversed Charge
fields.description: The portion of the refund returned by reversing the original card charge, in dollars.

fields.name: sr_store_credit
fields.label: Store Credit
fields.description: The portion of the refund issued as store or account credit to the customer, in dollars.

fields.name: sr_net_loss
fields.label: Net Loss
fields.description: The total financial loss to the retailer from the return, accounting for refunds, fees, and shipping costs, in dollars.

datasets.name: store_sales
datasets.description: A fact table containing individual line items from store sales transactions. Each row represents one product sold at a physical retail location, with details about the item, customer, timing, pricing, and profitability.

fields.name: ss_sold_date_sk
fields.label: Sold Date
fields.description: The date the sale was made, linked to the date dimension for time-based analysis.

fields.name: ss_sold_time_sk
fields.label: Time of Day
fields.description: The time of day the sale occurred, linked to the time dimension with hour, minute, and meal-time attributes.

fields.name: ss_item_sk
fields.label: Item
fields.description: Reference to the product sold; links to the item dimension which contains product details and pricing that may vary over time.

fields.name: ss_customer_sk
fields.label: Customer
fields.description: Reference to the customer who made the purchase; links to the customer dimension.

fields.name: ss_cdemo_sk
fields.label: Customer Demographics
fields.description: Reference to the customer's demographic profile including gender, marital status, education, credit rating, and dependents.

fields.name: ss_hdemo_sk
fields.label: Household Demographics
fields.description: Reference to household-level demographic attributes such as income band, buying potential, number of dependents, and vehicles.

fields.name: ss_addr_sk
fields.label: Customer Address
fields.description: Reference to the postal address associated with the sale; may represent the customer's current address or the address on the receipt.

fields.name: ss_store_sk
fields.label: Store
fields.description: Reference to the physical retail location where the sale occurred; links to the store dimension.

fields.name: ss_promo_sk
fields.label: Promotion
fields.description: Reference to any marketing campaign or promotion offering a discount on the item during the sale period.

fields.name: ss_ticket_number
fields.label: Ticket Number
fields.description: Identifier of the store sales receipt; groups all line items from a single store visit together.

fields.name: ss_quantity
fields.label: Quantity Sold
fields.description: Number of units of the item purchased on this sales line.

fields.name: ss_wholesale_cost
fields.label: Unit Wholesale Cost
fields.description: The per-unit cost to the retailer at the time of sale, in dollars.

fields.name: ss_list_price
fields.label: Unit List Price
fields.description: The per-unit list (undiscounted) price at the time of sale, in dollars.

fields.name: ss_sales_price
fields.label: Unit Sales Price
fields.description: The per-unit price actually charged to the customer before coupons, in dollars.

fields.name: ss_ext_discount_amt
fields.label: Extended Discount Amount
fields.description: Total markdown on the line, calculated as Quantity Sold × (Unit List Price − Unit Sales Price), in dollars.

fields.name: ss_ext_sales_price
fields.label: Extended Sales Price
fields.description: Gross line revenue before coupons and tax, calculated as Quantity Sold × Unit Sales Price, in dollars.

fields.name: ss_ext_wholesale_cost
fields.label: Extended Wholesale Cost
fields.description: Total cost to the retailer for the line, calculated as Quantity Sold × Unit Wholesale Cost, in dollars.

fields.name: ss_ext_list_price
fields.label: Extended List Price
fields.description: Total undiscounted value of the line, calculated as Quantity Sold × Unit List Price, in dollars.

fields.name: ss_ext_tax
fields.label: Extended Tax
fields.description: Sales tax charged on the line, computed on the Net Paid amount, in dollars.

fields.name: ss_coupon_amt
fields.label: Coupon Amount
fields.description: Coupon discount applied to the line after the sales price, in dollars.

fields.name: ss_net_paid
fields.label: Net Paid
fields.description: Revenue the customer actually paid before tax and shipping, calculated as Extended Sales Price − Coupon Amount, in dollars.

fields.name: ss_net_paid_inc_tax
fields.label: Net Paid Including Tax
fields.description: Total amount paid by the customer including sales tax, calculated as Net Paid + Extended Tax, in dollars.

fields.name: ss_net_profit
fields.label: Net Profit
fields.description: Line-level gross profit, calculated as Net Paid − Extended Wholesale Cost, in dollars.

datasets.name: time_dim
datasets.description: A dimension table containing one row for each second of a day (86,400 rows), with attributes for hour, minute, second, AM/PM indicator, work shift, sub-shift, and meal time. This table is used to add time-of-day context to transaction fact tables.

fields.name: t_time_sk
fields.label: Time Surrogate Key
fields.description: A unique surrogate key (0-86399) that uniquely identifies each second of the day.

fields.name: t_time_id
fields.label: Time ID
fields.description: An alternate unique identifier for each second of the day, encoded as a string.

fields.name: t_time
fields.label: Time of Day (Seconds)
fields.description: The number of seconds elapsed since midnight (0-86399), representing the time of day.

fields.name: t_hour
fields.label: Hour
fields.description: The hour of the day (0-23) in 24-hour format.

fields.name: t_minute
fields.label: Minute
fields.description: The minute within the hour (0-59).

fields.name: t_second
fields.label: Second
fields.description: The second within the minute (0-59).

fields.name: t_am_pm
fields.label: AM/PM Indicator
fields.description: Indicates whether the time falls in the morning (AM) or afternoon/evening (PM).

fields.name: t_shift
fields.label: Work Shift
fields.description: The work shift in which the time falls: first, second, or third shift.

fields.name: t_sub_shift
fields.label: Sub-Shift
fields.description: A finer division of the work shift, such as morning, afternoon, evening, or night.

fields.name: t_meal_time
fields.label: Meal Time
fields.description: The meal period in which the time falls (e.g., breakfast, lunch, dinner), or blank if not during a meal period.

datasets.name: warehouse
datasets.description: A master table of distribution facilities that hold inventory and ship catalog and web orders. Each row represents a unique warehouse location with its physical address, capacity, and time zone information.

fields.name: w_warehouse_sk
fields.label: Warehouse Surrogate Key
fields.description: A unique numeric identifier assigned to each warehouse for efficient database operations.

fields.name: w_warehouse_id
fields.label: Warehouse ID
fields.description: The business identifier for each warehouse, a unique alphanumeric code used in operational systems.

fields.name: w_warehouse_name
fields.label: Warehouse Name
fields.description: The descriptive name of the warehouse facility.

fields.name: w_warehouse_sq_ft
fields.label: Warehouse Square Footage
fields.description: The total floor space of the warehouse in square feet, indicating its storage capacity.

fields.name: w_street_number
fields.label: Street Number
fields.description: The street number component of the warehouse's physical address.

fields.name: w_street_name
fields.label: Street Name
fields.description: The street name component of the warehouse's physical address.

fields.name: w_street_type
fields.label: Street Type
fields.description: The type of street (e.g., Avenue, Parkway) for the warehouse's physical address.

fields.name: w_suite_number
fields.label: Suite Number
fields.description: The suite or unit number component of the warehouse's physical address.

fields.name: w_city
fields.label: City
fields.description: The city where the warehouse is located.

fields.name: w_county
fields.label: County
fields.description: The county where the warehouse is located.

fields.name: w_state
fields.label: State
fields.description: The state or province where the warehouse is located.

fields.name: w_zip
fields.label: Zip Code
fields.description: The postal zip code of the warehouse's location.

fields.name: w_country
fields.label: Country
fields.description: The country where the warehouse is located.

fields.name: w_gmt_offset
fields.label: GMT Offset
fields.description: The time zone offset from GMT in hours for the warehouse location, used for scheduling and reporting.

datasets.name: web_page
datasets.description: A slowly changing dimension table that tracks web pages from which orders or returns originated. Each row represents a version of a web page with its attributes, including content characteristics and temporal validity dates.

fields.name: wp_web_page_sk
fields.label: Web Page Surrogate Key
fields.description: Unique surrogate key identifying each row in the web page dimension.

fields.name: wp_web_page_id
fields.label: Web Page ID
fields.description: Business identifier for the web page, shared across multiple versions in this Type-2 slowly changing dimension.

fields.name: wp_rec_start_date
fields.label: Record Start Date
fields.description: The date when this version of the web page record became effective in the slowly changing dimension.

fields.name: wp_rec_end_date
fields.label: Record End Date
fields.description: The date when this version of the web page record expired; null indicates the current active version.

fields.name: wp_creation_date_sk
fields.label: Creation Date
fields.description: Foreign key to the date dimension indicating when the web page was created.

fields.name: wp_access_date_sk
fields.label: Access Date
fields.description: Foreign key to the date dimension indicating the most recent date the web page was accessed.

fields.name: wp_autogen_flag
fields.label: Auto-Generated Flag
fields.description: Indicator (Y/N) showing whether the web page was automatically generated.

fields.name: wp_customer_sk
fields.label: Customer
fields.description: Foreign key to the customer dimension; identifies the customer who owns or manages the web page. Null for 65% of records.

fields.name: wp_url
fields.label: URL
fields.description: The web address (uniform resource locator) of the page.

fields.name: wp_type
fields.label: Page Type
fields.description: The functional category of the web page (e.g., ad, welcome, checkout), used to classify pages by their purpose.

fields.name: wp_char_count
fields.label: Character Count
fields.description: The total number of characters in the web page content.

fields.name: wp_link_count
fields.label: Link Count
fields.description: The total number of hyperlinks present on the web page.

fields.name: wp_image_count
fields.label: Image Count
fields.description: The total number of images displayed on the web page.

fields.name: wp_max_ad_count
fields.label: Maximum Ad Count
fields.description: The maximum number of advertisements that can be displayed on the web page.

datasets.name: web_returns
datasets.description: Records of items returned by customers through web channels, capturing return transactions with refund amounts, fees, and payment methods. Each row represents one line item returned from a web order.

fields.name: wr_returned_date_sk
fields.label: Returned Date
fields.description: Date the return was processed, linked to the date dimension for time-based analysis.

fields.name: wr_returned_time_sk
fields.label: Time of Day
fields.description: Time of day the return was processed, linked to the time dimension with hour, minute, and shift attributes.

fields.name: wr_item_sk
fields.label: Item
fields.description: Reference to the product being returned; links to the item dimension which tracks product attributes and pricing over time.

fields.name: wr_refunded_customer_sk
fields.label: Refunded Customer
fields.description: The customer who received the refund, typically the original buyer of the item.

fields.name: wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
fields.label: Refunded Customer Demographics
fields.description: Reference to the demographic attributes of the customer receiving the refund.

fields.name: wr_refunded_hdemo_sk
fields.label: Refunded Household Demographics
fields.description: Reference to the household demographic attributes of the customer receiving the refund.

fields.name: wr_refunded_addr_sk
fields.label: Refunded Address
fields.description: Reference to the address where the refund was sent.

fields.name: wr_returning_customer_sk
fields.label: Returning Customer
fields.description: The customer who physically returned the goods; may differ from the refunded customer.

fields.name: wr_returning_cdemo_sk
fields.label: Returning Customer Demographics
fields.description: Reference to the demographic attributes of the customer who physically returned the goods.

fields.name: wr_returning_hdemo_sk
fields.label: Returning Household Demographics
fields.description: Reference to the household demographic attributes of the customer who physically returned the goods.

fields.name: wr_returning_addr_sk
fields.label: Returning Address
fields.description: Reference to the address from which the goods were returned.

fields.name: wr_web_page_sk
fields.label: Web Page
fields.description: Reference to the web page from which the original order was placed; tracked over time as pages are updated.

fields.name: wr_reason_sk
fields.label: Return Reason
fields.description: Reference to the reason code provided by the customer for the return.

fields.name: wr_order_number
fields.label: Order Number
fields.description: Identifier of the original web order; groups all line items returned from the same order.

fields.name: wr_return_quantity
fields.label: Return Quantity
fields.description: Number of units returned on this line item.

fields.name: wr_return_amt
fields.label: Return Amount
fields.description: Value of the returned goods refunded to the customer, before tax, in dollars.

fields.name: wr_return_tax
fields.label: Return Tax
fields.description: Tax refunded on the return, in dollars.

fields.name: wr_return_amt_inc_tax
fields.label: Return Amount Including Tax
fields.description: Total refund amount including tax, calculated as Return Amount plus Return Tax, in dollars.

fields.name: wr_fee
fields.label: Return Fee
fields.description: Restocking or handling fee charged to the customer for the return, in dollars.

fields.name: wr_return_ship_cost
fields.label: Return Ship Cost
fields.description: Shipping cost incurred to return the goods to the retailer, in dollars.

fields.name: wr_refunded_cash
fields.label: Refunded Cash
fields.description: Portion of the refund paid to the customer in cash, in dollars.

fields.name: wr_reversed_charge
fields.label: Reversed Charge
fields.description: Portion of the refund returned by reversing the original card charge, in dollars.

fields.name: wr_account_credit
fields.label: Store Credit
fields.description: Portion of the refund issued as store or account credit, in dollars.

fields.name: wr_net_loss
fields.label: Net Loss
fields.description: Total loss to the retailer from the return, accounting for refund, fees, and shipping costs, in dollars.

datasets.name: web_sales
datasets.description: Transaction-level fact table capturing individual line items from web orders, including product details, customer information, pricing, and financial metrics. Each row represents one item sold through a web channel.

fields.name: ws_sold_date_sk
fields.label: Sold Date
fields.description: Date the sale was made, linked to the date dimension for time-based analysis.

fields.name: ws_sold_time_sk
fields.label: Time of Day
fields.description: Time of day the sale was made, linked to the time dimension with hour, minute, and meal-time attributes.

fields.name: ws_ship_date_sk
fields.label: Ship Date
fields.description: Date the web order was shipped.

fields.name: ws_item_sk
fields.label: Item
fields.description: Product sold on this line; links to the item dimension which tracks product attributes and pricing over time.

fields.name: ws_bill_customer_sk
fields.label: Bill-To Customer
fields.description: Customer who was billed for the order; links to the customer dimension.

fields.name: ws_bill_cdemo_sk
fields.label: Bill-To Customer Demographics
fields.description: Demographic profile of the billing customer including gender, marital status, education, credit rating, and dependents.

fields.name: ws_bill_hdemo_sk
fields.label: Bill-To Household Demographics
fields.description: Household-level profile of the billing address including income band, buying potential, dependents, and vehicles.

fields.name: ws_bill_addr_sk
fields.label: Bill-To Address
fields.description: Postal address where the customer was billed; links to the customer address dimension.

fields.name: ws_ship_customer_sk
fields.label: Ship-To Customer
fields.description: Customer the goods were shipped to; links to the customer dimension.

fields.name: ws_ship_cdemo_sk
fields.label: Ship-To Customer Demographics
fields.description: Demographic profile of the shipping customer including gender, marital status, education, credit rating, and dependents.

fields.name: ws_ship_hdemo_sk
fields.label: Ship-To Household Demographics
fields.description: Household-level profile of the shipping address including income band, buying potential, dependents, and vehicles.

fields.name: ws_ship_addr_sk
fields.label: Ship-To Address
fields.description: Postal address where the goods were shipped; links to the customer address dimension.

fields.name: ws_web_page_sk
fields.label: Web Page
fields.description: Specific web page from which the order originated; links to the web page dimension which is tracked over time.

fields.name: ws_web_site_sk
fields.label: Web Site
fields.description: Retailer web property through which the order was placed; links to the web site dimension which is tracked over time.

fields.name: ws_ship_mode_sk
fields.label: Ship Mode
fields.description: Shipping service level and carrier used for the order; links to the ship mode dimension.

fields.name: ws_warehouse_sk
fields.label: Warehouse
fields.description: Distribution facility that shipped the order; links to the warehouse dimension.

fields.name: ws_promo_sk
fields.label: Promotion
fields.description: Marketing campaign offering a discount on the item; links to the promotion dimension.

fields.name: ws_order_number
fields.label: Order Number
fields.description: Identifier of the web order; groups all line items belonging to a single order.

fields.name: ws_quantity
fields.label: Quantity Sold
fields.description: Number of units of the item sold on this line.

fields.name: ws_wholesale_cost
fields.label: Unit Wholesale Cost
fields.description: Per-unit cost to the retailer at the time of sale, in dollars.

fields.name: ws_list_price
fields.label: Unit List Price
fields.description: Per-unit list (undiscounted) price at the time of sale, in dollars.

fields.name: ws_sales_price
fields.label: Unit Sales Price
fields.description: Per-unit price actually charged before coupons, in dollars.

fields.name: ws_ext_discount_amt
fields.label: Extended Discount Amount
fields.description: Total markdown from list price, calculated as Quantity Sold × (Unit List Price − Unit Sales Price), in dollars.

fields.name: ws_ext_sales_price
fields.label: Extended Sales Price
fields.description: Gross line revenue before coupons and tax, calculated as Quantity Sold × Unit Sales Price, in dollars.

fields.name: ws_ext_wholesale_cost
fields.label: Extended Wholesale Cost
fields.description: Total cost to the retailer for this line, calculated as Quantity Sold × Unit Wholesale Cost, in dollars.

fields.name: ws_ext_list_price
fields.label: Extended List Price
fields.description: Total undiscounted price for this line, calculated as Quantity Sold × Unit List Price, in dollars.

fields.name: ws_ext_tax
fields.label: Extended Tax
fields.description: Sales tax charged on the line, computed on the net paid amount, in dollars.

fields.name: ws_coupon_amt
fields.label: Coupon Amount
fields.description: Coupon discount applied to the line after the sales price, in dollars.

fields.name: ws_ext_ship_cost
fields.label: Extended Ship Cost
fields.description: Shipping charge on this web order line, in dollars.

fields.name: ws_net_paid
fields.label: Net Paid
fields.description: Revenue the customer actually paid before tax and shipping, calculated as Extended Sales Price − Coupon Amount, in dollars.

fields.name: ws_net_paid_inc_tax
fields.label: Net Paid Including Tax
fields.description: Revenue including sales tax, calculated as Net Paid + Extended Tax, in dollars.

fields.name: ws_net_paid_inc_ship
fields.label: Net Paid Including Ship
fields.description: Revenue including shipping cost, calculated as Net Paid + Extended Ship Cost, in dollars.

fields.name: ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax
fields.label: Net Paid Including Ship and Tax
fields.description: Total revenue including shipping and tax, calculated as Net Paid + Extended Ship Cost + Extended Tax, in dollars.

synonyms: Net Paid Including Ship and Tax

fields.name: ws_net_profit
fields.label: Net Profit
fields.description: Line-level gross profit, calculated as Net Paid − Extended Wholesale Cost, in dollars.

datasets.name: web_site
datasets.description: A slowly changing dimension that tracks web site properties including location, management, market assignment, and operational dates. Each row represents a version of a web site with validity dates.

fields.name: web_site_sk
fields.label: Web Site Surrogate Key
fields.description: Unique surrogate key for each web site record version.

fields.name: web_site_id
fields.label: Web Site ID
fields.description: Business identifier for the web site, stable across versions.

fields.name: web_rec_start_date
fields.label: Record Start Date
fields.description: The date this version of the web site record became effective.

fields.name: web_rec_end_date
fields.label: Record End Date
fields.description: The date this version of the web site record expired; null indicates the current version.

fields.name: web_name
fields.label: Web Site Name
fields.description: The business name of the web site.

fields.name: web_open_date_sk
fields.label: Open Date
fields.description: Foreign key to the date dimension indicating when the web site opened.

fields.name: web_close_date_sk
fields.label: Close Date
fields.description: Foreign key to the date dimension indicating when the web site closed; null if still operating.

fields.name: web_class
fields.label: Web Site Class
fields.description: Classification category for the web site.

fields.name: web_manager
fields.label: Web Site Manager
fields.description: Name of the manager responsible for the web site.

fields.name: web_mkt_id
fields.label: Market ID
fields.description: Identifier for the marketing region the web site belongs to.

fields.name: web_mkt_class
fields.label: Market Class
fields.description: Classification of the market segment for the web site.

fields.name: web_mkt_desc
fields.label: Market Description
fields.description: Descriptive text about the market the web site serves.

fields.name: web_market_manager
fields.label: Market Manager
fields.description: Name of the manager responsible for the market region.

fields.name: web_company_id
fields.label: Company ID
fields.description: Identifier for the legal company the web site belongs to.

fields.name: web_company_name
fields.label: Company Name
fields.description: Name of the legal company operating the web site.

fields.name: web_street_number
fields.label: Street Number
fields.description: Street number of the web site's business address.

fields.name: web_street_name
fields.label: Street Name
fields.description: Street name of the web site's business address.

fields.name: web_street_type
fields.label: Street Type
fields.description: Type of street (Avenue, Road, Way, etc.) for the web site's business address.

fields.name: web_suite_number
fields.label: Suite Number
fields.description: Suite or unit number of the web site's business address.

fields.name: web_city
fields.label: City
fields.description: City where the web site is located.

fields.name: web_county
fields.label: County
fields.description: County where the web site is located.

fields.name: web_state
fields.label: State
fields.description: State where the web site is located.

fields.name: web_zip
fields.label: Zip Code
fields.description: Postal zip code of the web site's location.

fields.name: web_country
fields.label: Country
fields.description: Country where the web site is located.

fields.name: web_gmt_offset
fields.label: GMT Offset
fields.description: Time zone offset from GMT in hours for the web site's location.

fields.name: web_tax_percentage
fields.label: Tax Percentage
fields.description: Sales tax rate applied to orders placed through this web site, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.08 for 8%).
